biggest_catch: The friend must be a genuinely NEW member - referrals of existing Heartland members earn nothing - and the referrer must be in good standing with their name listed on the application.
catches: Both the referring and the referred member earn $20 when the new member opens a membership.
New member must open a membership (minimum $5) and name the referring member on the online application or in-branch.
Referring member must be in good standing; Heartland employees are not eligible.
Referral bonus deposited into each Savings account within 30 days of account opening.
Cannot be combined with any other offer; program details subject to change.
Disclosure reads 'Offer valid 6/1/2026' (no end date stated; page live 2026-09-23) - read as the offer's effective date; confirm before relying on it.
